Regulator-filed 2012–13 operating report also explicitly lists her as a full-time Assistant Branch Secretary from 1 July 2012 to 30 June 2013. This earlier bounded full-time period is not extrapolated over gaps or the entire 2000–2014 tenure. Union work remains excluded from narrow employment headlines.

research_notes: Blocked: public department spell dated only to years with unresolved full-time/secondment status. Board roles and union jobs do not contribute to the two narrow headlines.
Official, personal, employer annual-report and regulator-hosted union evidence checked. Public LinkedIn returned 999; no bypass attempted.

Some secondary sources conflate 2006 and 2016 departmental secondment, and party biography gives 2017 branch-secretary timing against APH May 2018. Retain official dates pending primary appointment confirmation.
Direct full-time evidence found for one excluded union reporting interval; this is not transferred to the 2016–2017 department role. Earlier ASU dates still need primary confirmation.

Follow-up2026-10-02: added explicitly part-time Safeway first job, organiser start2000, confirmed department and Trades Hall secondments, recovered Vision exact board/chair dates and deputy role, and Equal Workplaces advisory membership.

Searches of official/state, union, employer and conference records did not resolve department hours, payroll or exact secondment dates, or early ASU promotion dates.2006 date in derivative biographies remains unadopted.2024 Vision fees paid to union are not personal full-time employment evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-03: regulator records now observe the assistant-secretary title by1 January2008, establish the exact25 July2014 president transition, the exact26 June2018 branch-secretary transition and2 June2024 cessation, and directly label the secretary as a full-time officer for1 July2022–2 June2024. Union work remains outside the two headline sectors.

Next follow-up: DPC appointment/secondment agreement or staff biography; primary election record for the original assistant-secretary appointment and evidence for work status outside the directly reported union intervals. Preserve headline nulls pending supported public FT interval; partial private job is not proof of zero lifetime FT work.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: the Portable Long Service Authority's primary2023–24 financial table records Darmanin as a director only through27February2024, materially refining the prior inherited April2024 endpoint while documenting the conflict. This governance role remains excluded and supplies no public-service FTE. DPC/Trades Hall searches still produced only derivative or conference biographies; they repeat a2006 campaign/secondment narrative but do not identify DPC payroll, exact appointment dates or hours. Headline public years remain uncalculable.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary annual report corrects Trust for Nature chair period and supplies exact trustee term. Added two undated qualifications and training-board, AIST, IFM advisory and Authority audit/risk roles; recovered exact Authority appointment1 September2022. Trades Hall campaign2006 distinguished from DPC2016–2017 secondment. Same-name Olympic sailor education rejected. Parliament-hosted PDF DisabledError recovered through employer PDF; HESTA committee primary fetch Internal Error remains follow-up lead. DPC dates, hours and payroll remain unresolved.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: primary 2012–13 branch operating report supplies an additional bounded full-time assistant-secretary period and contemporary training-board/HESTA governance observations. Union full-time periods remain explicitly bounded and excluded from the two employment headlines. A new useful lead is her 10 February 2011 equal-remuneration witness statement (FWC exhibit ASU 63); index appeared in public search, but page access returned HTTP403 in both web and ordinary urllib retrieval, so contents and earlier employment facts were not invented. A scratch requests import failed with ModuleNotFoundError; standard-library retrieval recovered the attempted access, with no job-wide tool failure. DPC/Trades Hall searches repeated known secondment narrative without payroll or hours. Next seek legitimate available copy of ASU63 and original DPC secondment contract, not generic biography. No numerical change.
